items.stem: On a Controller Area Network (CAN) bus, how is access to the bus resolved when two nodes transmit at the same time?

options.text: A central master grants each node a fixed time slot
options.rationale: Classic CAN has no central master; access is decentralised.

options.text: Non-destructive bit-wise arbitration based on message identifier priority
options.rationale: CAN uses bit-wise arbitration where the lower identifier (higher priority) wins without destroying the message.

options.text: The node with the longest message always wins
options.rationale: Message length does not determine arbitration.

options.text: Both messages are discarded and neither node retries
options.rationale: The winning message continues; the loser retries later.

items.explanation: CAN uses bit-wise arbitration where the lower identifier (higher priority) wins without destroying the message.

items.stem: What is the primary purpose of signal conditioning between a sensor and an ECU input?

options.text: To convert the vehicle into a hybrid
options.rationale: Signal conditioning is unrelated to powertrain type.

options.text: To scale, filter and protect the raw sensor signal so the ECU can read it accurately
options.rationale: Conditioning adjusts range, removes noise and protects the input so the microcontroller reads a valid value.

options.text: To increase the engine's compression ratio
options.rationale: That is a mechanical engine parameter, not an electronics function.
DTC storage is a diagnostic function, not signal conditioning.

items.explanation: Conditioning adjusts range, removes noise and protects the input so the microcontroller reads a valid value.

items.stem: A technician is diagnosing an intermittent CAN communication fault. Select TWO checks that are appropriate early steps.

options.rationale: Incorrect or missing termination is a common CAN fault and is quick to check.

options.text: Inspect connectors and wiring for intermittent open or short conditions
options.rationale: Intermittent faults frequently stem from wiring and connector problems.

options.text: Replace every ECU on the vehicle immediately
options.rationale: Wholesale replacement is costly and not an appropriate early diagnostic step.
Tyre pressure has no bearing on CAN communication.
A cosmetic change cannot address a physical-layer communication fault.

items.explanation: Incorrect or missing termination is a common CAN fault and is quick to check.
